title: Neow Companions
description:
Choose companions after Neow's starting relic.

Neow Companions adds a large roster based on Slay the Spire 2 creatures, elites, and bosses. Each companion has a combat figure, relic icon, custom card, card art, and themed animation behavior.

Recent highlights:
- Added companions for the remaining base-game enemies, with act-based companion pools.
- Companion pool lists are available in Mod Config with base and upgraded card previews.
- Optional settings can show all eligible companion choices and grant both the base and upgraded companion card.
- Companion cards have more enemy-themed mechanics instead of only dealing damage.
- Companion figures use complete native skins and animation assets, including multipart creatures.
- Decimillipede's three animated segments move and resize as one companion.
- Companions remember manually adjusted positions and sizes between combats.
- Right-click dragging now targets fitted live sprite bounds; hold both mouse buttons to inspect every target zone without dragging.
- Toadpole uses its native attack, idle, sound, and death animation clips.
- Rocket and Crusher are excluded as standalone choices because they are already represented by Kaiser Crab.
- Card art uses black backgrounds. Card, relic, icon, and companion visuals use authentic in-game assets. No AI-generated art.

Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: Expanded the roster to remaining base-game enemies and reorganized choices into act-based pools. Added pool previews in Mod Config, optional base + upgraded card grants, more thematic card mechanics, complete native skins and animations, linked Decimillipede movement, native Toadpole animations, and fitted sprite-bound dragging. Card art has black backgrounds. All visuals use authentic in-game assets. No AI-generated art.
